lease.child_action: Use this lease. Do not acquire, release, reset, switch branches, or change lease records.

objective: Remove the confirmed maintenance-driven completion polling in the fault-watchdog MCAP sink while preserving legitimate batching and flush deadlines, accepted-write ordering, error reporting, and shutdown/finalization behavior.
constraints: Only this confirmed finding is in scope. The Dora readiness candidate remains unresolved and is excluded.
Inspect actual consumers and storage contracts. Do not just delete writer.poll if this loses aged-batch flushing or changes required failure/completion behavior.

Important design or behavior choices, added complexity, dependency adoption, new environment contracts, and edits outside allowed paths require a needs_decision result before implementing them. Explain the smallest viable option and alternatives with exact evidence.
No new configuration input or dependency is approved. Existing APIs may be used within their documented contracts.
The controller owns skill-based leasing, commits, pushes, PRs, independent verification, and lease release. Do not invoke skills or delegate. Do not edit scan artifacts.

If a routine in-scope repair is possible, implement it and add only meaningful regression coverage. Use focused unprivileged release/locked checks. No full CI, ARM64 jobs, system administration, or privileged tests in this child; report required capability tests for the controller.
Report tests actually run separately from gaps. patch_ready means proposed patch for controller verification, never verified or merged.
This host can fail sandboxed shell startup with bwrap RTM_NEWADDR. If encountered, request narrowly scoped automatic approval for the necessary operation; do not change system or sandbox settings.
acceptance: Idle completion handling no longer depends on repeated maintenance timeouts.
Timers correspond to actual operation deadlines.
Batch age and configured flush semantics are preserved or any change is explicitly presented for approval.
Packet arrival, queue admission, failure/poisoning, ordering, disconnect, and finalization behavior remain valid.

output_contract.evidence_lines: One-based line number of the first line; quote must match consecutive current source lines.
output_contract.needs_decision: Return concrete question, recommended option, alternatives, and tradeoffs; stop before dependent edits.
output_contract.blocked: Return observed failure and what would unblock it.
